test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Doctors are raising __hue and cry__ against the RTH bill.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Protest'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning for the underlined part is: **'protest'.**
 
• The idiom **"hue and cry"** means **a noisy expression of public anger or disapproval.**
